requirements.title: Story Bible 引擎
requirements.description: 扩展 KnowledgeEngine + 自动提取 + 语义层
requirements.acceptance: SB entity types defined, auto-extraction from manuscript, inline editing

requirements.title: AI 自动续写模式
requirements.description: Auto mode — AI free continuation with context
requirements.acceptance: Auto mode generates continuation, creativity slider works, streaming output

requirements.title: AI 引导选择模式
requirements.description: Guided mode — 3 scored options for user selection
requirements.acceptance: 3 options generated, quality scores displayed, user can select and adjust

requirements.title: AI 指令驱动模式
requirements.description: Directed mode — user specifies intent, AI generates per instruction
requirements.acceptance: User instruction parsed, AI generates per instruction, revision protocol integrated

requirements.title: 读者模拟引擎
requirements.description: 预设 + 自定义角色，4 维度检查

requirements.title: 读者模拟可视化
requirements.description: 叠加现有 + 详情联动
requirements.acceptance: Overlay on tension curve, detail panel, click-through linkage

requirements.title: 质量控制机制
requirements.description: 硬约束 + 软约束创意谱图
requirements.acceptance: Hard constraints from CAS enforced, creativity spectrum slider, mode-specific enforcement

requirements.title: 多模态故事智能
requirements.description: 文本操作语义 + 可视化扩展
requirements.acceptance: Text operation semantics defined (filter/lasso/perspective), visual extension path

constraints.constraint: All new capabilities MUST be exposed through MCP endpoints
constraints.rationale: Unified integration surface, consistent API layer

constraints.constraint: Story Bible MUST extend existing KnowledgeEngine
constraints.rationale: Avoid parallel engine data sync issues

constraints.constraint: AI output MUST be framed as first draft quality
constraints.rationale: Position as writing partner, not replacement

constraints.constraint: MVP MUST include Co-Writing (Auto+Guided) + Reader Simulation (3 presets)
Directed mode MUST NOT have frontend implementation in MVP
constraints.rationale: Design-only in MVP, implementation in Phase 2

constraints.constraint: Multi-Modal Intelligence MUST NOT have implementation in MVP
constraints.rationale: Phase 3, text-only design exploration in Phase 2

domain.problem_statement: niko-studio has mature writing analysis capabilities but lacks AI-driven active creation assistance. Users need to upgrade from passive analysis to AI co-creation experience.

terminology.definition: Structured story knowledge base with characters/world rules/plot threads/timeline entities
AI co-creation engine supporting Auto/Guided/Directed three modes
Multi-persona multi-dimension reader experience simulation engine
Two-tier constraint system: hard constraints (CAS) + soft constraints (creativity spectrum)

domain.audience: Fiction writers using desktop writing assistant

non_goals.title: 发布平台
non_goals.rationale: Not writing core capability, belongs to distribution layer

non_goals.title: 模板库系统
non_goals.rationale: Pure rule/template system without AI, violates AI-driven priority constraint

non_goals.title: 实时多人协作
non_goals.rationale: Research shows this domain is not mature yet

insights.summary: SB quality gate is critical path — incomplete SB degrades all downstream capabilities
Co-Writing → Reader Simulation → Multi-Modal is the optimal delivery sequence
Inline hints + sidebar detail is the optimal display pattern for AI suggestions
Plot coherence, character consistency, style consistency, pacing/tension are the essential quality dimensions

open_questions.question: When should Multi-Modal Intelligence move from MAY to SHOULD/MUST?
options: After Co-Writing + Reader Simulation are stable

open_questions.question: Should Directed mode be available as experimental/alpha in MVP?
